summary: Executed backend regression suites plus new bonus-pick API tests, and ran end-to-end customer slots UI validation (skins, HUD, settings toggles, spin API, tooltip behavior, bonus overlay picks). Core requested flows passed.
action_items: Optional maintainability improvement: add data-testid attributes to remaining interactive customer login/main-tab controls currently using id/text-only selectors.
Optional tech-debt: replace deprecated Three.js CDN build include with module-based import path (warning only; no functional break observed).
critical_code_review_comments: customer.html is very large and mixes extensive styles + JS inline; splitting slot UI/logic into modular assets would reduce regression risk and improve long-term maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with public URL https://card-game-suite-3d.preview.emergentagent.com/asiakas using TestPelaaja/test123 (player id 1). Bonus overlay appears after free-spin sequence when bonus_game present; in automation it may require extended wait (up to 120s) due cinematic flow timing.
rca of the issue: No blocking app defects found in requested scope. Earlier automation timeout was due test script waiting for bonus overlay too early while free-spin cinematic was still in progress; extending wait resolved it.
